name: Eldet
source:
You play as Kunal, a man in his early 20s, who has spent the past sixteen years of his life studying at a college of mages--only to realize that, despite coming from a family of famous mages, he may have no magical powers of his own.   

Nevertheless, when he is contacted by a mysterious "tomb raider" seeking to hire a mage for a purpose he won't disclose, he seizes upon the opportunity to leave the college, whatever the consequences. The demo opens to a scene prior to your departure from the college, and proceeds to reveal just what it is the tomb raider has hired you to do, ending with the discovery that you may not be so powerless after all.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1094149316/eldet/description]Kickstarter page[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演二十出头的男子库纳尔。他人生中前十六年都在法师学院求学，却发现自己出身于著名法师家族，可能仍然没有任何魔法天赋。

然而，一名神秘的“盗墓者”联系他，想雇用法师完成一项不愿透露目的的工作。库纳尔抓住这个离开学院的机会，不顾一切后果。试玩版从他离开学院前的场景开始，逐渐揭示盗墓者雇用他要做什么，并以发现他或许并非毫无力量而告终。

[来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1094149316/eldet/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
